title: Hiring For Btech/BCA/Bsc/MBA freshers For Data Governance in Mysore
description:
Hiring for Freshers Btech/BE/BCA/Bcs/MCA/MBA Freshers from 25 batch for Data Governance in Mysore 
 As a Process Executive, you will support data quality, analytics, reporting, and automation initiatives across multiple business processes. You will gain hands-on experience in database querying, Python-based automation, web data extraction, Power BI reporting, and data governance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and data reliability. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Analytics Write SQL queries to support data analysis, ad hoc reporting, and business requirements. Support the monitoring and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reports used for client reporting and data quality tracking. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across systems. Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand business requirements and support data quality improvement initiatives. Assist in documenting analytical findings, business requirements, and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 Automation Assist in the development and maintenance of database objects, including tables, views, stored procedures, and functions. Learn and support existing ETL and automation frameworks, helping monitor data pipelines, identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure smooth execution of scheduled jobs. Develop and support Python-based scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation, and process automation. Assist in web scraping and data collection initiatives using Python and related libraries to gather information from internal and external data sources. Contribute to automation and process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and data reliability. 
 Data Governance Process and manage Collibra access requests for data assets and views, ensuring adherence to established data governance standards, processes, and service level agreements (SLAs). Support data governance activities by maintaining proper documentation, access controls, and compliance with defined policies and procedures. 
 Must have: Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Knowledge of Python programming, including data analysis libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. Understanding web scraping concepts and exposure to tools such as Beautiful Soup, Selenium, or Scrapy. Familiarity with Power BI, Excel, and data visualization concepts. Basic understanding of ETL processes, data quality, and data governance principles. Knowledge on MS Excel Pivot, Summarization and Basic formulas. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Eagerness to learn new technologies and work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Flexible working in a 24x5 rotational shift environment. Commitment to working from the office five days a week as per organizational requirements. Qualification 
 Btech/BE/Bsc/BCA/MBA Freshers 2025-2026 pass out 0 year Experience 
 Note Working from office Rotational and Night shift Location of posting: Mysore Excellent verbal and written communication skills Must be a good team player Good problem - solving skill 
 Regards, Infosys BPM Recruitment team

Key Skills: Power Bi,Good Communication In English,SQL,Data,Python,English,Bi,Data Governance
